errors: Says a preflight is triggered by 'a method other than GET or POST'. In fact HEAD is also a simple method, and the main triggers are PUT, DELETE and PATCH.

Says preflight is triggered by 'a custom header such as Authorization'. This is fine, but the answer leaves out that the preflight must also include Access-Control-Allow-Origin. It does list that header, so this is a minor point only.
Says the server must answer the preflight with status 200 or 204. Any 2xx status works, so this is slightly too narrow but not wrong in practice.
